privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.desc: How visitor information is handled on this site
privacy.body:
## 1. Scope

This policy applies to the school portal (the "Site"). By using the Site you agree to the practices described here.

## 2. Information we collect

The Site is fully static: there is **no registration, login, comment or form submission**, and no personal data is actively collected. The hosting provider may log technical data such as access time, requested page, IP address, browser and operating system, and referrer. These are used only for availability and statistics.

## 3. Cookies and local storage

The Site sets no tracking cookies. The hosting platform or content delivery network may set necessary technical cookies for security and caching. You may refuse or clear cookies in your browser without losing access to content.

## 4. Third-party resources

Some fonts, images and scripts may be served by third-party object storage or a content delivery network, which may log requests. We do not sell or share your personal information.

## 5. External links

Links to other websites are governed by their own policies; we take no responsibility for them.

## 6. Security

We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect the Site and its logs from unauthorised access, alteration or disclosure.

## 7. Minors

The Site publishes school information to the public and does not collect personal information from minors. Guardians may contact us about any inappropriate content.

## 8. Updates

This policy may be updated as the Site changes; the new version takes effect when published on this page.

## 9. Contact

For questions about this policy, please use the telephone numbers on the Contact page.

## 6. Seguridad

Aplicamos medidas técnicas y organizativas razonables para proteger el Sitio y sus registros frente a accesos, alteraciones o divulgaciones no autorizados.

El Sitio publica información pública y no recopila datos de menores. Los tutores pueden contactarnos por cualquier contenido inadecuado.

本サイトおよびログへの不正アクセス・改ざん・漏えいを防ぐため、合理的な技術的・組織的措置を講じます。

## 7. 未成年者の保護

本サイトは公開情報の発信を目的とし、未成年者から個人情報を取得しません。不適切な内容があれば保護者の方からご連絡ください。

本ポリシーは必要に応じて改定されます。改定版は本ページに掲載された時点で効力を生じます。
